# telnyx_inbound_voice_channel_settings (Resource)

The number of inbound voice channels of the account in the US zone. There is one per account; destroy removes it from Terraform state only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The account's inbound voice channels in the US zone. There is one per
# account.
resource "telnyx_inbound_voice_channel_settings" "this" {
  channels = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channels` (Number) The current number of concurrent channels set for the account

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always inbound_voice_channel_settings: there is one per account.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the response

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_inbound_voice_channel_settings.example inbound_voice_channel_settings
```
